issue: A second code review found that v1 treated each DBF row as a distinct station. The source display Station label is reused at different coordinates, while some repeated visits/duplicate rows have identical point geometry. V1 therefore counted repeated rows at the same exact location/date more than once in the leave-one-station-out baseline.
v2_station_identity: Exact EPSG:4269 source-point longitude/latitude pair. The Station/Org_Stn strings are retained as descriptive labels only; no fuzzy-distance tolerance is introduced.
v2_duplicate_rule: Aggregate all valid T2m readings for the same exact point location and same Area/exact Date by their median before counting distinct stations and computing leave-one-location-out residuals.
post_selection_limit: The v1 public-proxy scores were already observed before this source-identity correction was implemented. The v2 same-fold scores are exploratory implementation sensitivities, not a confirmatory independent holdout, and cannot clear a weekly competition slot. The v2 candidate also differs from v1 at only 54 positive cells in the same direction; it is a corrected file variant, not a new conceptual method.
